hero.h1: The build matches the Figma file. Every page.
hero.sub: Agents compare each page to Figma and the brand guide, on desktop and phone. Your team decides what to fix. Your client approves from the staging link.
hero.clientLine: Your client taps Approve on the webflow.io staging link from their phone.

pack.name: Studio Handoff Pack
pack.intro: Eight agents for the handoff. They run on every page of the staging site, desktop and phone, and post findings as comments.

agents.name: Figma Match
agents.checks: Compares the built page to its Figma frame on desktop and phone.

agents.name: Breakpoint Check
agents.checks: Finds overlap, clipping and side scroll at tablet and phone widths.

agents.name: Font Guard
agents.checks: Checks every font on the page against the brand guide.
agents.finding: Footer uses Arial. The guide allows Inter only.

agents.name: Interaction Check
agents.checks: Opens menus, accordions and modals and checks hover and focus states.
agents.finding: Mobile menu opens but the close button does nothing.

agents.name: Staging Links
agents.checks: Finds links, forms and images that still point at staging.

agents.name: Noindex Check
agents.checks: Finds pages still blocked from search after launch.
agents.finding: noindex is still set on 14 pages. Google can't see the site.

agents.name: Image Weight
agents.checks: Finds images large enough to slow the page on phone.
agents.finding: Hero image is 4.8 MB. Phone load passes six seconds.

agents.name: Share Image
agents.checks: Checks the favicon and share image render on every page.
agents.finding: Share image is the Webflow default on 9 pages.

buildYourOwn.input: Flag any page where the CTA button text is not 'Book a call'.
buildYourOwn.finding: 6 pages use 'Get started'. The brief says 'Book a call'.

faq.q: Does Figma Match need the Figma file?
faq.a: Yes. Upload the file or paste a share link. The agent compares each page to its frame on desktop and phone.

faq.q: Does it work on Webflow and Framer staging domains?
faq.a: Yes. Agents check webflow.io and framer.website links, and pages behind a password.

faq.q: Can the client comment on the staging site?
faq.a: Yes. Send one link. They comment and approve on the page with no account.
